# Ember (ember-radeon)

> Ember is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) AMD Radeon GPU control center for Linux: an AMD Software Adrenalin Edition–style app for Wayland and X11. It does overclocking, undervolting, fan curves, power limits, per-game profiles, FSR 4, Anti-Lag, Radeon Super Resolution–style upscaling, image sharpening, FreeSync/HDR display settings and GPU monitoring, all in one app. Repository: https://github.com/noble6/ember-radeon

Ember drives the open amdgpu kernel driver through its documented sysfs interface (pp_od_clk_voltage, power_dpm_force_performance_level, pp_power_profile_mode, hwmon pwm1/power1_cap, gpu_od/fan_ctrl, gpu_metrics) through a sandboxed root service (emberd, systemd, JSON over a Unix socket). It drives Mesa/Proton/gamescope/MangoHud/vkBasalt features through a per-game launcher (`ember-run %command%`). UI: PySide6/QML, Material 3.

## Supported hardware
AMD Radeon on amdgpu: RDNA 4 (RX 9070 XT/9070/9060 XT), RDNA 3/3.5 (RX 7900 XTX → 7600, 780M/890M), RDNA 2 (RX 6950 XT → 6400, Steam Deck, 680M), RDNA 1 (RX 5700 XT/5600/5500), Vega (Vega 56/64, Radeon VII), Polaris (RX 580/570/480/470/560/550), GCN 1–3 on amdgpu, and Ryzen APUs. Multi-GPU supported. FSR 4 on RDNA 2/3/4 via Proton-GE or proton-cachyos (RX 6000 uses the INT8 model).

## Features
- Live monitoring: clocks, edge/hotspot/memory temperature, power vs. limit, fan RPM, VRAM, throttling reasons, per-app GPU and VRAM usage (DRM fdinfo), CSV logging
- Tuning: performance level, workload profile, power limit, fan curve editor (PWM, or the RDNA 3+ firmware curve), zero RPM, fan target temperature, overclock and undervolt in each generation's format (voltage offset, V/F curve, per-state voltage, RDNA 4 clock offset), apply at boot with a crash guard
- Gaming: Steam library, automatic game detection with an in-game "Ember active" banner (MangoHud), automatic per-game tuning profiles, non-Steam games (Flatpak such as Sober/Roblox, Lutris, Heroic, Bottles, native) added from a picker of installed apps with menu launchers; per-game FSR 4 upgrade, FSR 3 + FSR 3 frame generation in any DLSS/XeSS game (OptiScaler), FSR Redstone frame generation, Anti-Lag (Mesa layer), Super Resolution / VSR / integer scaling (gamescope), CAS sharpening, FXAA/SMAA, anisotropic filtering, Enhanced Sync, FPS cap, HDR, MangoHud overlay; can write Steam launch options safely
- Record: recording and Instant Replay with the GPU hardware encoder (gpu-screen-recorder), screenshots, global hotkeys that work in fullscreen games (KDE), automatic replay with games, clips organized per game, live streaming to Twitch/YouTube/RTMP
- Display (KDE Plasma): FreeSync/VRR policy with the EDID FreeSync range, refresh rate, resolution, HDR, wide color gamut, color depth (bpc), RGB range, DDC/CI brightness
- Updates itself: daily check of GitHub releases, checksum-verified install through a systemd timer
- System: driver/hardware report, Smart Access Memory (ReBAR) status, shader cache reset, detection of legacy radeon-driver cards

Note: FSR 4, FSR 3 via OptiScaler and Redstone frame generation are experimental on Linux. They may break some games and are toggled per game; avoid OptiScaler in online games with anti-cheat.

## Install
git clone https://github.com/noble6/ember-radeon && cd ember-radeon && ./install.sh
Needs Python 3.10+, PySide6, systemd. Arch/CachyOS: packaging/aur/PKGBUILD. Optional: mangohud, vkbasalt, gamescope, proton-cachyos or Proton-GE.
